% hypcap's all option with hyperref and cleveref in a report: figures
% numbered by chapter, a short title in the list of figures, and each
% number, \ref, and \cref as in the PDF.
\documentclass{report}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage[all]{hypcap}
\usepackage{cleveref}
\begin{document}
\listoffigures
\chapter{Alpha}
\begin{figure}[h]
  \centering
  \fbox{One}
  \caption[Short]{Long title}\label{fig:one}
\end{figure}
\chapter{Beta}
\begin{figure}[h]
  \centering
  \fbox{Two}
  \caption{Second figure}\label{fig:two}
\end{figure}

Cref: \cref{fig:one}; \Cref{fig:two}.

Ref: \ref{fig:one}; \ref{fig:two}.
\end{document}
